source_name: DKOM – Prekrškovne zadeve (misdemeanour/infringement proceedings)
why_relevant: DKOM also acts as the misdemeanour authority against contracting authorities that breach procurement law. Infringement files reference the Public Procurement Portal publication number of the contract, linking a sanction to a specific tender – useful for spotting authorities that award banking/IT-payment contracts irregularly.

source_name: DKOM – National Review Commission (English pages)
why_relevant: English-language description of mandate, procedure and (some) reporting for the Slovenian review body; useful for cross-border comparison and for naming conventions in English-language reporting ('National Review Commission').

source_name: Računsko sodišče RS – Arhiv revizij (Court of Audit audit archive)
why_relevant: Full-text audit reports of public-fund users. Audits of ministries, agencies and state-owned financial institutions routinely inspect procurement legality and payment/cash-management arrangements, naming banks, contract values and irregularities that never surfaced cleanly on the procurement portal. A confirmed example: the audit of SID banka operations found the Ministry of Finance had not ensured compliance with public procurement rules at the bank.

source_name: Računsko sodišče RS – Seznam revidirancev (auditee index, incl. Banka Slovenije)
why_relevant: Entity-indexed view of every audit ever performed on a given body. The Banka Slovenije auditee page aggregates all audits of the central bank (e.g. supervisory-function audits); equivalent pages exist for SID banka, ministries and agencies. This is the fastest actor-first route into audit material relevant to banking and payments.

source_name: Court of Audit of the Republic of Slovenia – English site and English audit reports
why_relevant: Selected audit reports and infographics published in English; lowers translation cost for the subset of audits that touch financial-sector procurement and state financial institutions.

source_name: Računsko sodišče RS – Javna naročila (its own procurement publications)
why_relevant: The Court of Audit publishes its own contract awards, including the statutory annual list of below-EUR-40,000 contracts. Small but concrete: shows which suppliers (incl. payment/banking service providers) serve a control institution, and demonstrates the statutory 'seznam javnih naročil pod 40.000 EUR' obligation that applies to every Slovenian authority – a generalizable low-threshold disclosure vein.

source_name: KPK – Zaključne ugotovitve / odločitve komisije (final findings on concrete cases)
why_relevant: Published case findings of the anti-corruption commission, including cases on tenders allegedly tailored to a pre-selected bidder and breaches of procurement transparency. These name officials, authorities and often the favoured supplier – revealing contracts and relationships that procurement notices alone do not expose.

source_name: KPK – Analiza korupcijskih tveganj v postopkih javnega naročanja
why_relevant: Systemic KPK analysis of corruption risks in procurement procedures – gives the typology of manipulations (spec-tailoring, split contracts, single-bid awards) that an analyst should look for when reading award notices for bank/payment contracts, and often cites concrete case material.

source_name: ERAR (KPK application: public-sector transaction records)
why_relevant: KPK-run database of actual money flows from public-sector bodies to legal and natural persons (10-year retention, relaunched 2024/2025). Lets an analyst see what a public body actually PAID a bank, card processor or POS/IT supplier – i.e. real contract execution value versus the awarded value, and supplier relationships never tendered. The most powerful indirect confirmation source in this cell.

source_name: KPK – Sporočila za javnost (press releases)
why_relevant: Earliest public signal that KPK has opened or closed a case; often summarises findings before the full document is posted, and flags systemic themes (e.g. procurement in state-owned financial institutions).

source_name: KPK archive site (arhiv.kpk-rs.si)
why_relevant: Legacy KPK content (older findings, FAQs, guidance) that was not migrated to the current CMS. Necessary for historical depth on procurement cases predating the site redesign.

source_name: MJU – Statistična poročila o oddanih javnih naročilih (annual procurement statistics)
why_relevant: Statutory annual statistical report on all awarded public contracts: values, procedure types, number of bids, breakdown by contracting authority and subject. Enables sizing of the addressable public-sector market for banking/payment/IT-payment services and year-on-year trend analysis.

source_name: OPSI – Odprti podatki Slovenije (open data portal, procurement & Erar datasets)
why_relevant: Machine-readable mirror/registry for the statistical-report collection and the ERAR cash-flow dataset, plus a discovery surface for other procurement-adjacent datasets. Preferred over scraping the HTML front-ends where a dataset exists.

source_name: Sodna praksa RS – Iskalnik sodne prakse (case-law database, Upravno sodišče review of DKOM)
why_relevant: Since 1 January 2021 certain DKOM decisions can be challenged before the Administrative Court in Ljubljana. Those judgments (UPRS sodbe) restate the facts of the disputed tender – bidder names, specs, values – and give a second, independent narrative of the same procurement dispute, including cases where DKOM's decision was overturned.

source_name: PISRS – Pravno-informacijski sistem RS (legal basis: ZPVPJN, ZRacS-1, ZIntPK, ZJN-3)
why_relevant: Authoritative consolidated texts of the laws that define what each review/audit body must publish and when – the disclosure-obligation map that tells an analyst which documents MUST exist. PISRS also carries National Assembly recommendations responding to specific Court of Audit reports (e.g. on Banka Slovenije supervisory functions), which are themselves intelligence.

source_name: Tax-Fin-Lex – Zbirka sodne prakse (commercial legal database)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that indexes DKOM decisions and court practice with editorial abstracts (jedro, institut, pravna podlaga). Its indexing can surface procurement-review material that is hard to find via the official search, but it is paywalled.

source_name: IUS-INFO – KPK annual report and procurement legal commentary
why_relevant: Hosts parliamentary attachments such as the KPK annual report (LETNO POROČILO) and legal commentary on procurement review. Useful as a secondary retrieval path when the primary institutional link has moved.

source_name: Državni svet / Državni zbor RS – opinions on DKOM and KPK annual reports
why_relevant: Parliamentary/second-chamber opinions on the review body's annual report add critical commentary and sometimes name systemic problem areas (sectors with recurring disputes, capacity constraints) that the body itself understates.

source_name: European Court of Auditors – special reports on public procurement (SR 17/2016 etc., Slovenian versions)
why_relevant: EU-level audit of procurement in cohesion spending, published in Slovenian, gives comparative benchmarks and describes EU-funded procurement in Slovenia – relevant where bank/payment infrastructure is EU co-financed and where national audit bodies follow up ECA findings.

source_name: Legacy DKOM decision archive (pre-redesign URL scheme, www.dkom.si/odlocitve_DKOM/)
why_relevant: Older decisions (observed timestamps back to 2005) still resolve under the pre-redesign path. Needed for long-horizon analysis of who has historically contested banking/payments tenders in Slovenia; the current listing claims coverage from 2002 but the legacy URLs are what older citations point to.

source_name: OPSI — Evidenca podatkov o denarnih tokovih subjektov javnega sektorja (75.a in 75.b člen ZIntPK)
why_relevant: The formal open-data catalogue record behind ERAR: publisher KPK, licence CC BY 4.0, monthly update frequency. This is the legally clean, citable entry point for ERAR cash-flow data and the place where any future machine-readable resource (beyond the HTML app) would appear.

source_name: OPSI Metapodatkovni API (CKAN metadata API)
why_relevant: Documented machine interface to the OPSI catalogue, JSON. Makes automated, low-friction monitoring of new procurement/contract/payment datasets feasible instead of manual browsing — the collection backbone for this whole cell.

source_name: UJP JN Plačila — poročanje o izvršenih plačilih iz naslova javnega naročanja
why_relevant: Since 1 Jan 2023 contracting authorities must report monthly on ACTUAL payments executed against public procurement contracts above EUR 40,000; UJP forwards this to the ministry which publishes it on the public procurement portal alongside the contract. This is the authoritative contract-level payment-execution layer — it turns an award notice into a real spend trajectory per vendor (e.g. processing, ATM maintenance, card issuing frameworks).
